payload.title: [Figs. 11-12] LMR v2.1 vs Büntgen et al ensemble
payload.description: This workflow compares the LMR v2.1 dataset with the ensemble from Büntgen et al., 2021, focusing on Northern Hemisphere summer temperatures. It quantifies the distance between these datasets and reproduces figures 11 and 12 from the study.
